text:
Sam: @here quick midday challenge tomorrow: Treadmill Tempo (20min intervals) vs Boulder Bingo (10 climbs, try to hit as many listed moves as possible). Loser buys kombucha and tells a dad joke at standup.
Alex: Treadmill for me. trying to keep my cardio streak alive. :runner:
Jordan: Boulder Bingo sounds like chaos and I love it. who's making the bingo card? :bingo:
Mei: I'll make the bingo card. categories: "heel hook", "dyno", "slab", "matching shoes", "chalk spill" etc.
Carlos: Ill do either. note: treadmill is on lane 2 (low belt speed), bring headphones.
Sam: Signup: `@name - pick - meetup - notes`
Alex: `@Alex - treadmill - gym - headset + pace 5:00/km`
Jordan: `@Jordan - bingo - wall - will bring spare tape`
Mei: `@Mei - bingo - wall - making card + prizes`
Carlos: `@Carlos - either - gym - will adapt`
Sam: Current tally: 2 bingo / 1 treadmill + 1 flexible. Facilities okayed extra towels.
Sam: small rule: bingo winners pick the loser's dad joke category (puns, bad science, or work humor).
Alex: :thumbsup: as long as the treadmill has incline for suffering.
FitBot: Reminder set  "Treadmill Tempo vs Boulder Bingo" tomorrow 12:20. React with :bell: to confirm.
Jordan: :bell: also Mei, bingo with a "chalk spill" square is cursed but necessary.
Mei: :smile: I'll hide one REALLY obvious heel hook to spice things up.
Carlos: If the gym's busy we can rotate 10-min blocks so people still get sets in.
Sam: Deal. Winner gets to pick kombucha flavor. Loser supplies kombucha and the dad joke.
Alex: Prepare for puns. May the best calves win.
